meta.name: The Body
meta.description:
On Halloween night, an all-girls dance squad tumbles into Catholic guilt, unholy desires and ghostly visions when an initiation goes to hell.

Complete series. On your server: S1 8/8

videos.title: Slutty God
videos.overview: After dance team hopefuls Lisbeth and Grace audition for an open spot, the squad initiates their new teammate in a hell-raising Halloween ritual.

videos.title: Jesus, Literally
videos.overview: Haunted by a guilty conscience, Anya tries to limit the fallout from Halloween night. Lisbeth exploits an opportunity to rise above her social status.

videos.title: Unholy Thoughts
videos.overview: Unsettling dreams shake the Lions' team spirit. Suspicion falls on a guilt-stricken Leo after his drawing of Grace makes the rounds at school.

videos.title: I Saw Grace Franklin with the Devil
videos.overview: As visions of Grace spread, Anya tries a hands-on approach to managing her anxiety. Elise leverages Leo's innocence to infiltrate Lisbeth's home life.

videos.title: Faking It
videos.overview: The Lions head to the country to prep for regionals, but when they try to save Grace by exorcising their demons, the weekend spirals into unholy chaos.

videos.title: Star Quality
videos.overview: Sidelined at regionals by a miraculous recovery, Lisbeth preys on a teammate's weakness. An electric performance reignites Anya and Elise's connection.

videos.title: Holy Trinity
videos.overview: Lisbeth copes with a change in circumstances. Steven makes a disturbing discovery. A shocking confession tests Father Franklin's limits.

videos.title: Coming Out
videos.overview: Sinful secrets threaten to tear Anya's world apart as Father Franklin chases answers, Elise demands the truth and Lisbeth makes a cunning Hail Mary move.

meta.slogan: They pray hard and sin harder.
